posts.t: Hi Redbull and Pucci referring to # 146...my inputss.....please add your comment too.

Hello Everyone!

God it's been ages since I posted! Ok so the image below is how my day so far has gone. I am going to try my logic at explaining the trades that hit SL. The stops where behind the thick orange lines. 1 & 2 were taken off of an FTR area and what I was thinking at the time (knowing very well that we hit H1 supply), we were going to head deeper into supply creating an FO b4 dropping. It seems price just lost steam and rolled over. Post-mortem: I should have taken heed once the oval broke... I'm with them as I participated and followed my rules to the pip.

3,4,& 5 were taken off of the QM zone created during London earlier in the day. My heart did not race for one second during this whole time. On the contrary I was very calm and composed, even when I was adding to the initial trade lower. I got nervous when we hit the brown line with momentum. Something was telling me close close close C-L-O-S-E... Not only did I fail to close (obviously at the time I did not see the brown line, all my eyes wanted to see was the target!), I also failed to put the SLs at BE+... Post-mortem: Should open my eyes for momentum FOs....I also did not follow my rules of bringging SL to even plus.... the latter is what bothers me the most. I'm with myself for that.

Those trades off of QM got to a point double my initial return of all the ones that preceded them. Having lost that does not bother me at all, it's not about the profits IT'S ABOUT THE RULES (I'm shouting at myself as I type)...

In Summary: I'm still up 3.27% on the day....

Also it is worth mentioning that most losses I take are during the London/NY overlap... I don't know why yet....

That's it... trade well, trade safe
